svg.title: Chapter II · THE RAVEN'S EYE
svg.desc: Comic panel, chapter II · THE RAVEN'S EYE. Pixel art: a black raven with a red eye perched on a branch in front of a full moon. Agentic Earth-observation platform: SAR + optical imagery with visual question answering. Stack: Python, PyTorch, LangGraph, Rasterio.
